description: Get TikTok videos for a username, a hashtag or a search keyword. The body is {mode: profile|hashtag|search, query, limit} and limit runs 1-20. Each video has id, url, text, created_at, author, plays, likes, comments, shares, saves, duration_s, hashtags and music; no expiring media links. raw true returns the original records. A leading @ or # in the query is stripped.

limit.description: number of videos wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

mode.description: profile=user's videos, hashtag=videos under a tag, search=keyword→videos

query.description: username (profile), hashtag without #, or search keywords

raw.description: true returns the provider's own records instead of the compact shape

name: tiktok
title: TikTok videos by user, hashtag, search
